confidence.$comment: V2 Phase 1 addition (BL-013, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md), optional. Per the blueberry import package's own proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-3: relationships were the one core edge type with no structured confidence, forcing it into free text inside `notes` (e.g. "confidence=medium; ...") where nothing could query it. Same low/medium/high vocabulary already proven on Fact and (this task) Assessment. `notes` is unchanged and not removed -- existing records with confidence expressed as notes-text remain valid; this field is additive, not a replacement.
